national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Visits Bishkek for 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, on a two-day visit to attend the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Summit.
The theme of the summit is '25 Years of the SCO: Together Towards Sustainable Peace, Development and Prosperity', focusing on counter-terrorism and regional stability.
Key engagements include bilateral talks with leaders of Armenia, Kyrgyzstan, Iran, and Russia, alongside attending the 6th World Nomad Games.

national_news.title: DoT and Himachal Pradesh Partner to Accelerate National Broadband Mission 2.0
bullets: The Department of Telecommunications (DoT) partnered with the Himachal Pradesh government to speed up implementation of National Broadband Mission (NBM) 2.0 and Digital Bharat Nidhi (DBN)-funded projects.
NBM 2.0 focuses on extending Optical Fibre Cable (OFC) network and high-speed broadband to rural, hilly, border, and unserved areas.
The mission aims to ensure last-mile digital connectivity to primary health centers, schools, Anganwadi centers, and Gram Panchayat offices.

national_news.title: India and Brazil Hold 8th Trade Monitoring Mechanism Meeting in Brasilia
bullets: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal co-chaired the 8th India-Brazil Trade Monitoring Mechanism (TMM) meeting in Brasilia alongside Brazil's Tatiana Lacerda Prazeres.
Both nations reaffirmed their target to scale bilateral trade to USD 30 billion by 2030, following a trade volume of USD 15.07 billion in 2025-26.
Key focus areas included expanding the India-MERCOSUR Preferential Trade Agreement and easing pharmaceutical market access leveraging the CDSCO-ANVISA MoU signed in February 2026.

national_news.title: Consumer Affairs Ministry Notifies Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026
bullets: The Department of Consumer Affairs notified the Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026, mandating IST as the common standard time reference across official, commercial, and digital systems nationwide after a 180-day transition period.

The policy encourages the use of NavIC (India's satellite navigation system) and local time dissemination infrastructure to reduce dependency on foreign satellite time sources across critical sectors like banking, telecom, and power grids.

Under the 'One Nation, One Time' initiative, a White Rabbit Technology-based IST Dissemination Demonstration Network was commissioned at RRSL Bengaluru to ensure precise and secure time synchronization.

national_news.title: India and Uzbekistan Elevate Relations to Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
bullets: India and Uzbekistan elevated their bilateral ties to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and established a framework for the long-term supply of uranium and rare earth mineral mining.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred with Uzbekistan's highest honor for foreign leaders, the 'Oliy Darajali Do’stlik' Order (Order of Friendship of the Highest Degree).

Both nations set a bilateral trade target of $5 billion by 2030 and agreed on MoUs covering Ayurveda, tourism, digital public infrastructure, and the restoration of Buddhist sites Fayaz Tepa and Kara Tepa.

national_news.title: India Dispatches HADR Assistance to Flood-Hit Nepal
bullets: India provided 68.5 tonnes of emergency relief materials, along with technical teams and forensic experts, to assist Nepal following severe flash floods along the Bhote Koshi River.
The World Health Organization (WHO) allocated $150,000 from its Emergency Fund to address immediate health needs in affected districts including Rasuwa, Nuwakot, and Dhading.
Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) operations were deployed to assist in evacuations and support affected Indian nationals in the border regions.

national_news.title: PM Highlights Women Empowerment via PM SVANidhi and Mission ShaktiSAT
bullets: Nearly 35 lakh women entrepreneurs across India have utilized the PM SVANidhi scheme for economic empowerment and business expansion.
Phase II of 'Mission ShaktiSAT' was launched at Gautam Buddha University in Greater Noida, training approximately 12,000 female students from 108 countries in satellite technology.
The Prime Minister emphasized the nationwide 'Nasha-Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat' campaign against drug abuse and promoted the 'Vocal for Local' movement.

national_news.title: AISHE Data Highlights a Decade of Growth in India's Higher Education Sector
bullets: As per the All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) by the Ministry of Education, the number of universities in India grew by 69.6% from 760 in 2014–15 to 1,289 in 2023–24.

Total student enrolment increased by 31.5% from 3.42 crore to 4.50 crore, pushing the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) to 30% in 2023–24 towards the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 target of 50% by 2035.
Female enrolment in higher education outpaced overall growth, rising by 42.2% from 1.57 crore in 2014–15 to 2.24 crore in 2023–24.

national_news.title: FSSAI Issues Prohibition of Sale Order for Substandard Compounded Hing
bullets: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, issued a Prohibition of Sale order for Compounded Hing produced by Everest Food Products and LG Brand Unit due to safety standard violations.
Under the FSS (Food Products Standards and Additives) Regulations 2011, Compounded Hing must contain a minimum of 5% alcohol-soluble extract; tested commercial samples contained only 0–3%.
Surveillance tests also found starch levels of 15% to 32% in raw hing samples, significantly exceeding the permissible regulatory ceiling of 1%.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Announces All-Women Mahila Vishwavidyalaya and Financial Support Schemes
bullets: Bihar announced plans for a proposed Mahila Vishwavidyalaya where all academic, administrative, faculty, and leadership positions (including Vice-Chancellor) will be reserved exclusively for women.

The state government disbursed approximately ₹600 crore via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to nearly 5 lakh beneficiaries under the Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana and outlined a target to spend ₹20,000 crore by 2030 for JEEViKA Didis.

The announcements were made during the launch of the Samriddh Mahila Samriddh Bihar Abhiyan in Patna, alongside an MoU signed with Prajapita Brahma Kumari Ishwariya Vishwavidyalaya for anti-addiction awareness.

bihar_news.title: Bihar and Jharkhand Sign Historic Sone River Water Sharing Pact
bullets: Bihar and Jharkhand signed a water-sharing agreement for the Sone river, resolving a 25-year dispute originating after Jharkhand was carved out of Bihar in November 2000.

The allocation formula grants 5.75 million acre-feet (MAF) of water to Bihar and 2.0 MAF to Jharkhand, adhering to the 7.75 MAF share originally assigned to undivided Bihar under the 1973 Bansagar Agreement.

The resolution was mediated by the Central Water Commission (CWC) under the Union Ministry of Jal Shakti following discussions at the Eastern Zonal Council meeting chaired by Union Home Minister Amit Shah.

bihar_news.title: India Averts River Surge in Bihar Following Nepal Flash Flood
bullets: The Trishuli and Kali Gandaki rivers join at Devghat in Nepal to form the Narayani River, which enters India as the Gandak River in Bihar.
The Central Water Commission (CWC), under the Ministry of Jal Shakti, issued a flood advisory to Bihar and Uttar Pradesh following a sharp rise in the Trishuli river near the Nepal-Tibet border.
Bihar Water Resources Department regulated the water surge by opening all 36 gates of the Gandak Barrage at Valmikinagar, safely discharging excess water into the downstream Ganga river system.

bihar_news.title: Finance Ministry Outlines Cycle for Union Budget Preparation
bullets: The Department of Economic Affairs (DEA), under the Ministry of Finance, issues the Budget Circular initiating pre-budget consultations chaired by the Secretary (Expenditure).
Financial Advisers of various ministries upload expenditure details onto the Union Budget Information System (UBIS) to finalize Budget Estimates and Revised Estimates.
Estimates for direct and indirect taxes, surcharges, and cesses are compiled and furnished by the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) and the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC).

bihar_news.title: Executive Notifications Cannot Be Applied Retrospectively Rules Patna High Court
bullets: Patna High Court ruled that beneficial executive policy decisions and resolutions of the government cannot be applied retrospectively in the absence of explicit statutory provision.
The ruling clarified that courts cannot expand the temporal scope or financial terms of an executive scheme beyond its stated text.
The case examined a 2005 Bihar government resolution that expanded extraordinary family pension benefits to all government personnel dying in harness due to acts of violence.
